user.title: Zigbee2MQTT Manager
user.description: Connects the manager to your Zigbee2MQTT instance through the MQTT integration.

data_description.base_topic: Matches `mqtt.base_topic` in the Zigbee2MQTT configuration (default: zigbee2mqtt).

error.invalid_topic: Invalid base topic (empty or containing # or +).
error.topic_overlap: Base topics of several instances must not be nested (e.g. “zigbee2mqtt” and “zigbee2mqtt/stick2”). Use separate ones such as “zigbee2mqtt” and “zigbee2mqtt2”.

abort.already_configured: An entry for this base topic already exists.
abort.mqtt_unavailable: The MQTT integration is not set up or not connected.

data_description.critical_battery_threshold: Must be less than or equal to the “low battery” threshold.
data_description.fire_events: Fires e.g. zigbee2mqtt_manager_device_offline, _battery_low and _update_available – usable as automation triggers.

error.critical_above_low: The critical threshold must not exceed the “low” threshold.

permit_join.name: Control pairing
permit_join.description: Starts or stops pairing mode on the Zigbee2MQTT bridge.
